title: Direct identifying column
trigger: Released reviewed name/contact/identifier field with corroborated nonplaceholder values
message_template: {count} released records still contain {identifier_kind}; a recipient can read or match those values.
external_prerequisites: No auxiliary data needed to read the values; naming an opaque ID may need a reference.

title: Identifiers inside ordinary text
trigger: Narrative or string cells regardless of column label
message_template: Local scanning found {count} potential or confirmed identifier spans in {fields}; coverage is {coverage}.
external_prerequisites: No auxiliary data needed for exposed names/contact values; contextual detections can require review.

title: Government or account identifier
trigger: Validated format plus reviewed person/account context
message_template: {identifier_kind} remains in the proposed output; format validation is not a claim about ownership.
external_prerequisites: An account/identity reference may be needed to name the owner.

title: Credential exposed
trigger: Confirmed or strongly patterned credential in released cells
message_template: The proposed output includes a possible active credential. PRISM did not test it against any service.
external_prerequisites: No online testing; rotate/revoke through the owner's normal procedure when confirmed.

title: Unclassified highly distinguishing field
trigger: Unknown semantics with cardinality/unique-count signal
message_template: {field} distinguishes {count} rows but its meaning is unresolved; privacy interpretation needs review.
external_prerequisites: No real identity implication established.

title: Birth date and geography
trigger: birth_date plus residence/postal geography for same subject
message_template: Knowing {fields} leaves one candidate for {unique_count} {unit} in this release.
external_prerequisites: Knowledge of these attributes and target participation; identified reference needed for naming.

title: Demographic and physical combination
trigger: Age or demographic plus height/weight/other physical attribute, optionally geography
message_template: The combination {fields} narrows candidates more than the individual fields; {small_count} {unit} have fewer than five candidates.
external_prerequisites: Correct approximate attributes at their released resolution.

title: Generic identifying combination
trigger: Any supported structural QI subset, independent of Jev
message_template: {fields} produces {groups} distinct groups; {unique_count} {unit} are unique under this matching model.
external_prerequisites: The selected known attributes; sample rather than population matching.

title: Workplace and occupation
trigger: Employer/workplace plus job title/demographics for same person
message_template: Work-related details distinguish {count} {unit}; public staff information is a possible source, not verified here.
external_prerequisites: An identified employment reference, not assumed public.

title: Birthplace and temporal detail
trigger: Origin location plus birth date/age for same subject
message_template: Origin and temporal details yield {min_candidates} minimum candidates in this release.
external_prerequisites: Correct origin and age/date knowledge.

title: Missingness fingerprint
trigger: Distinct missing/suppression patterns across released columns
message_template: The pattern of blank or suppressed fields itself distinguishes {count} {unit}.
external_prerequisites: Knowledge of the person's observed/missing pattern.

title: Appointment linkage opportunity
trigger: Encounter/appointment time plus facility/location with supported same-event relation
message_template: Someone who knows the visit time and place would have {candidate_summary}; {unique_count} {unit} have one candidate.
external_prerequisites: External appointment knowledge; no appointment database presumed available.

title: Position and timestamp
trigger: Physical coordinates plus observation time for same event
message_template: The current space-time precision creates {unique_count} unique event signatures; subject counts are {subject_scope}.
external_prerequisites: Known positions/times and subject association.

title: Home and work combination
trigger: Supported same-person residence and workplace
message_template: The home/work combination narrows candidate groups to {candidate_summary}.
external_prerequisites: An external source connecting both locations to a person.

title: Death or notable event linkage
trigger: Death/notable event date plus person-associated geography
message_template: The date/location combination distinguishes {count} {unit}; an identified public report would supply a linkage route if available.
external_prerequisites: Relevant identified event reports must be supplied or explicitly assumed.

title: Sensitive cohort context
trigger: File title/approved metadata/constant condition or facility defines sensitive membership
message_template: Even with indistinguishable rows, learning someone belongs to this cohort could reveal {sensitive_category}; membership exposure is a separate question.
external_prerequisites: Evidence someone participated; unknown unless supplied or demonstrated.

title: Homogeneous sensitive group
trigger: Released sensitive target and Q group containing one nonmissing sensitive category
message_template: All {group_count} candidates in this group share {sensitive_category}; identifying one row is unnecessary under known membership.
external_prerequisites: Target is known to belong to this matching group; group values must be observable.

title: Strong sensitive concentration
trigger: Group modal frequency >=0.90 and lift over release baseline >=0.20, with >=5 valid target records
message_template: Within {fields}, one outcome accounts for {group_rate}, versus {baseline_rate} across this release. This is an observed association, not a population prediction.
external_prerequisites: Applicable target membership and known group attributes.

title: Sensitive distribution divergence
trigger: Nominal t distance exceeds configured 0.20 review threshold
message_template: This group's sensitive-value distribution differs from the release distribution by {distance} under {distance_name}.
external_prerequisites: No real attack success claimed by the distance alone.

title: Identity connected to sensitive target
trigger: Corroborated direct person identifier released with same-subject restricted target
message_template: The release connects {identifier_kind} to {sensitive_category}; blurring unrelated fields does not remove that link.
external_prerequisites: Readability of direct identity or available identifier reference.

title: Evaluated attribute inference gain
trigger: Valid baseline and disjoint evaluation design with release-informed attacker
message_template: The specified attacker improved by {advantage} on {n_targets} held-out targets, compared with the same prior knowledge without this release.
external_prerequisites: Exact evaluation design and reference distribution stated in evidence.

title: Observed cohort membership linkage
trigger: Supplied identified reference has verified matches into a sensitive cohort
message_template: The supplied reference linked {correct_count} known people to membership in this cohort under the tested matching rule.
external_prerequisites: The actual supplied identified reference; success validated with private ground truth.

title: Date reconstructed from another field
trigger: Declared anchor and duration/end-date dependency reconstructs suppressed exact date
message_template: {fields} recover the hidden date to {resolution}, despite its removal from {hidden_field}.
external_prerequisites: Public released anchor and dependency; private audit data used only to validate.

title: Centered-range inversion
trigger: Output intervals centered on source with public symmetric encoding and verified midpoint recovery
message_template: The displayed range still reveals its center exactly. Shared bins remove this reversible encoding.
external_prerequisites: Only the output range and its declared encoding are needed.

title: Duplicate field defeats scrubbing
trigger: Source identifiers or precise values remain in an alias/duplicate/string column
message_template: {field} was protected, but equivalent source information remains in {alias_fields}.
external_prerequisites: Equivalence must be declared or verified, not inferred solely from correlation.

title: One-to-one relabeling preserves distinctions
trigger: Reviewed transformation is injective over observed categories
message_template: Every original category still maps to a distinct output category; {metric} is unchanged. This is pseudonymization, not coarsening.
external_prerequisites: Public decoding is not assumed; distinctiveness itself survives.

title: Hidden raw precision in export
trigger: Serialized file retains raw values behind generalized display or extra column
message_template: The actual exported artifact retains {raw_representation}; the visual blur did not remove it.
external_prerequisites: Inspect the exported artifact; no auxiliary data required.

title: Crosswalk/key exported with data
trigger: Export bundle contains source-to-token mapping or reversible key material
message_template: The export includes the information needed to reverse {transformation}; keep it in the owner-only workspace.
external_prerequisites: The mapping/key accompanies the release.

title: Row order or exported index linkage
trigger: Source index preserved or matching order known across supplied releases
message_template: The retained {ordering_key} can align these releases; order is not harmless metadata when another file supplies identities.
external_prerequisites: Earlier order/index must be accessible; absent reference means hypothesis only.

title: Stable pseudonym across releases
trigger: Exact token intersections in supplied releases
message_template: {matched_tokens} persistent tokens connect records across releases, including {connected_categories}.
external_prerequisites: Possession of both releases; naming a person requires additional evidence.

title: Declared weak identifier hash
trigger: Known algorithm/domain plus authorized candidate dictionary, or missing key evidence
message_template: The declared transformation {scheme} is {assessment}; hash appearance alone cannot establish security.
external_prerequisites: Actual scheme and authorized dictionary required for demonstrated reversal; otherwise Needs assessment.

title: Unexpected token namespace reuse
trigger: Same identifier namespace used where release isolation was requested
message_template: The configured token namespace permits cross-project joins contrary to the selected isolation policy.
external_prerequisites: Observed namespace/configuration evidence; no key recovery claimed.

title: Distinctive event sequence
trigger: Repeated-subject events with reliable ordering and supported subject mapping
message_template: {count} subjects have unique tested sequences; this covers {window_definition}, not every possible trajectory attack.
external_prerequisites: Knowledge of the tested event sequence and its subject association.

title: Shifted dates retain intervals
trigger: Per-subject shift plus interval pattern or a supplied true anchor
message_template: Date shifting preserves intervals; {recovery_statement} under the supplied anchor scenario.
external_prerequisites: No exact-date recovery claim without an actual anchor/dependency.

title: Transaction receipt linkage
trigger: Amount plus merchant/counterparty and transaction time for same event
message_template: A receipt-like combination leaves {candidate_summary} matching transactions in the release.
external_prerequisites: An identified transaction/receipt with the selected fields.

title: Device or account history linkage
trigger: Persistent device/account key plus behavior/timing content
message_template: The key groups {events} events into histories; ownership is {ownership_status}.
external_prerequisites: An external ownership record is needed to attach a name.

title: Related-person disclosure
trigger: Explicit family/household/caregiver edges with identifiers or sensitive facts
message_template: The release links related subjects and {sensitive_category}; {verified_relationship_scope}.
external_prerequisites: Declared edges and supported inference; never infer real kinship from appearance.

title: Selected genetic-marker combination
trigger: Scalar mutation/variant categories with demographics
message_template: The selected scalar marker combination distinguishes {count} {unit}; full genomic linkage is not assessed.
external_prerequisites: Compatible externally known marker information.

title: High-dimensional biological/biometric data
trigger: Genome/embedding/voice/image-like content outside enabled format adapters
message_template: This content requires specialized privacy testing beyond the enabled tabular checks.
external_prerequisites: No safety conclusion from the ordinary CSV scan.

title: Contextual narrative identification
trigger: Narrative person/relationship descriptions without a conclusive local span detector
message_template: Narrative descriptions may identify someone without a name; current coverage does not evaluate that fully.
external_prerequisites: Manual or specialized review; no invented specific person.

title: Protection by deleting a subgroup
trigger: Suppression removes people disproportionately or loses a required query cohort
message_template: The risk metric improved after removing {count} records, but {query_or_group} changed by {loss}.
external_prerequisites: Owner-only source comparison; no privacy improvement inferred from denominator alone.

title: Duplicate rows inflate apparent k
trigger: Repeated subject IDs or duplicate events inflate row group size above person group size
message_template: The group has {rows} rows but only {subjects} confirmed people; report person-based candidates instead.
external_prerequisites: Reliable private subject mapping required; otherwise Needs assessment.

title: Multiple interval releases narrow identities
trigger: Supplied linked releases publish different intervals for same attributes
message_template: Combining released intervals narrows {count} values to {intersection_summary}, although each looked broad separately.
external_prerequisites: Both releases plus valid linkage; do not align by guessed row order.

title: Suppressed aggregate recoverable from margins
trigger: Exact totals and complementary cells determine a suppressed cell
message_template: Published totals recover the supposedly suppressed value under this query workload.
external_prerequisites: Access to all enumerated totals/cells and their definitions.

title: Neighboring cohort differencing
trigger: Permitted exact queries differ by one protected person's bounded contribution
message_template: Subtracting {query_b} from {query_a} exposes one person's contribution in the demonstrated scenario.
external_prerequisites: Known nested cohorts and contribution interpretation.

title: Aggregate reconstruction feasibility
trigger: Specified linear query system with valid domains and solver evidence
message_template: {count} protected values are fixed across all feasible solutions of the supplied query system.
external_prerequisites: Known query equations/domains; rank alone is insufficient.

title: Original identifiers copied into synthetic output
trigger: Exact contextual source-identifier matches in claimed synthetic release
message_template: The proposed synthetic output contains {count} source-identifier matches; generation alone did not remove them.
external_prerequisites: Original used locally to validate residual identifiers.

title: Synthetic attack evaluation
trigger: Valid train/synthetic/control inputs and enabled Anonymeter adapter
message_template: {attack_name} produced {result} relative to its baseline/control, within the stated synthetic-data evaluation.
external_prerequisites: Control data must not have been used in generation.

title: Unsupported formal privacy claim
trigger: A release is labeled DP or certified but mechanism evidence is absent/incomplete
message_template: The supplied output does not establish the claimed mechanism guarantee; missing evidence: {missing}.
external_prerequisites: Mechanism configuration and proof/accounting evidence required.

title: Incomplete or failed analysis
trigger: Scan error, capped coverage, unresolved critical interpretation or unavailable engine
message_template: {tests} were not completed. Their absence is not evidence of protection.
external_prerequisites: Complete or explicitly narrow the assessment.

title: Metadata identifies a subject
trigger: Supported export metadata contains corroborated person identifiers
message_template: Identifying information remains in {artifact_part}, outside the visible table.
external_prerequisites: Read the artifact metadata; no external source required.

title: Evidence report leaks source details
trigger: Public report includes source identifiers, exact rare values, raw examples or private crosswalk
message_template: The report exposes owner-only information that the protected dataset omitted.
external_prerequisites: Report must be treated as a separate data release.

title: External schema correspondence unresolved
trigger: Original/protected fields cannot be reliably mapped
message_template: The field comparison for {fields} is unresolved; PRISM will not invent row or column correspondence.
external_prerequisites: Reviewed schema mapping; source pairing remains owner-only.

title: Invalid source/control split
trigger: Synthetic/inference evaluator's control overlaps training subjects
message_template: The comparison would reuse training subjects as controls and cannot support the intended privacy claim.
external_prerequisites: Independent control evidence; subject-disjointness rather than row-disjointness.

title: Unit confusion threatens protection
trigger: Body mass versus sampling weight ambiguity or incompatible measured units
message_template: {field} cannot safely use {transform} until meaning and units are confirmed.
external_prerequisites: Do not guess kilograms from plausible magnitude.

title: Unresolved event timezone or pairing
trigger: Time/facility combination cannot be interpreted consistently
message_template: The event linkage test needs {missing_relation}; structural row uniqueness is still available.
external_prerequisites: Same-event and timezone/reference interpretation.

title: Stale or mismatched assessment
trigger: Evidence version differs from active candidate/semantics/workload
message_template: These results belong to a different candidate. Recalculation is required before exporting the current assessment.
external_prerequisites: Exact version identity.

title: Semantic drift across reuse
trigger: Cached mapping applied outside confirmed domain/schema
message_template: The saved interpretation of {field} is not confirmed for this dataset context.
external_prerequisites: Scoped reviewed dictionary and current schema.

title: Verified auxiliary identity linkage
trigger: Authorized reference matching with separate private truth validates identity assignments
message_template: The specified reference linked {correct} of {eligible} eligible targets; {incorrect} asserted links were wrong.
external_prerequisites: Only supplied reference features, never private audit alignment as attack input.

title: Marginals preserved but relationships destroyed
trigger: Specified joint/correlation query fails while marginal distributions remain unchanged
message_template: The individual distributions survived, but {query} changed from {before} to {after}.
external_prerequisites: A defined research query; not every future analysis.
